== Summary ==
[[Brian Herold]] (centre, dark jacket, looking at the camera) at the [[2009 World Championship]], Princeton, New Jersey, 10 October 2009. The photographer's Flickr title is "my fargo brethren Brian"; when the photo was posted to the forum, quesosauce37 replied "i didnt know brian herolds dad was Grand Admiral Thrawn".

== Source ==
Photo by Flickr user punkybear (forum user Nibcrom): [https://www.flickr.com/photos/punkybear/4096911958/ my fargo brethren Brian] (original image https://live.staticflickr.com/2647/4096911958_9bf5050fce_b.jpg). Posted to the forum in a [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=482550#p482550 post by Nibcrom] (12 November 2009) and identified in the [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=483086#p483086 reply by quesosauce37] (14 November 2009), topic 31192. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005202/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t31192.html Internet Archive]
